label: Pure determinations are jointly compossible within the admissible family
paraphrase: OPEN, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: joint compossibility of pure perfections relative to one admissible family. If q is an admissible profile whose members are all pure, and k is pure and occurs in some admissible profile, then q with k added is admissible. It is a one-step insertion law; pairwise compatibility of pure determinations does not imply it, and it does not say that every set of pure determinations is admissible.
